{
  "feasibility": {
    "verdict": "answerable_with_configuration",
    "answerable": [
      "Day-of-year of snowmelt onset at each individual SNOTEL station via per-site single-column ELM runs validated against observed SWE",
      "Elevation control on melt onset by comparing melt DOY across the 6 stations spanning ~1400-1800 m",
      "Local lapse rate between closely-spaced (<12 km) stations on the same ridge, provided forcing is elevation-downscaled with a locally-fit temperature lapse rate"
    ],
    "not_answerable": [
      "Aspect/slope or radiation-driven melt differences (no aspect data or multi-facet forcing provided)",
      "Distributed spatial melt patterns between stations (site archetype gives point columns only, not a continuous surface)"
    ]
  },
  "n_columns": 6,
  "n_justification": "One column per SNOTEL station is required to resolve site-specific melt onset and to fit a local lapse rate; 6 stations exist in the Naches (17030002), several <12 km apart on shared ridges, giving the elevation gradient needed to derive lapse-rate-controlled melt timing.",
  "columns": [
    {"id": "bumping_ridge", "lat": 46.868, "lon": -121.310, "soil_texture": "gravelly_sandy_loam"},
    {"id": "morse_lake", "lat": 46.928, "lon": -121.393, "soil_texture": "sandy_loam"},
    {"id": "pigtail_peak", "lat": 46.646, "lon": -121.402, "soil_texture": "gravelly_loam"},
    {"id": "white_pass_es", "lat": 46.635, "lon": -121.391, "soil_texture": "sandy_loam"},
    {"id": "cougar_flat", "lat": 46.836, "lon": -121.117, "soil_texture": "loam"},
    {"id": "corral_pass", "lat": 46.965, "lon": -121.470, "soil_texture": "gravelly_sandy_loam"}
  ],
  "elm_config": {
    "DATM_CLMNCEP_YR_START": "1980",
    "DATM_CLMNCEP_YR_END": "2018",
    "STOP_N": "39",
    "RUN_STARTDATE": "1980-01-01",
    "hist_variables": [
      "H2OSNO",
      "SNOWDP",
      "SNOW_DEPTH",
      "QSNOMELT",
      "QFLX_SNOMELT",
      "FSNO",
      "SNOWLIQ",
      "SNOWICE",
      "TSA",
      "TBOT",
      "TSOI",
      "FSDS",
      "FLDS",
      "RAIN",
      "SNOW",
      "QRUNOFF"
    ]
  },
  "requires_capabilities": [
    "Elevation-based downscaling of atmospheric forcing (temperature lapse-rate and precipitation adjustment) to each station elevation",
    "Locally-fit temperature lapse rate between same-ridge station pairs (e.g., White Pass/Pigtail; Morse Lake/Corral Pass)",
    "Snowmelt-onset detection algorithm (first sustained SWE decline / DOY of peak-SWE-to-melt transition) applied to daily H2OSNO output",
    "SNOTEL SWE ingestion for per-site calibration/validation",
    "STOP_N units set to nyears; multi-year spinup (recycle 1980-2000 forcing) to equilibrate snow/soil states"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Station coordinates and elevations approximate real Naches (HUC 17030002) SNOTEL sites; exact metadata should be pulled from NRCS before production runs",
    "Base CLMNCEP forcing is downscaled to each column elevation using a lapse rate initially set to -6.5 K/km then refined from observed inter-station temperature contrasts",
    "Melt onset defined as the first DOY after peak SWE with a sustained multi-day SWE decrease exceeding a noise threshold",
    "Vegetation set to evergreen needleleaf boreal/temperate consistent with subalpine forest at these elevations",
    "Soil textures assigned from SSURGO/gridded estimates and held per-column; refine with site data if available"
  ]
}

answerable: Day-of-year of snowmelt onset at each individual SNOTEL station via per-site single-column ELM runs validated against observed SWE
Elevation control on melt onset by comparing melt DOY across the 6 stations spanning ~1400-1800 m
Local lapse rate between closely-spaced (<12 km) stations on the same ridge, provided forcing is elevation-downscaled with a locally-fit temperature lapse rate
not_answerable: Aspect/slope or radiation-driven melt differences (no aspect data or multi-facet forcing provided)
Distributed spatial melt patterns between stations (site archetype gives point columns only, not a continuous surface)
